summary: Orchid Island Capital announced via Form 8-K that its board approved an increase to its existing stock repurchase program by an additional 25 million shares, bringing total authorization to approximately 26.6 million shares, representing about 13.3% of outstanding common stock. No price, premium, or other terms were specified. The repurchases may be executed through open-market or private transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, and are subject to market conditions and legal requirements. There is no obligation to purchase any specific amount, and the program has no termination date. Watch for actual repurchase activity and potential impacts on per-share metrics.
